newsitem.title: USA: U.S. consumer groups ask FDA for aspartame review.
newsitem.headline: U.S. consumer groups ask FDA for aspartame review.

text.p: Two U.S. consumer groups called on the Food and Drug Administration to conduct a new safety review of the sweetener aspartame.

The Consumer Federation of America and the Consumer Nutrition Institute based the request on a newly published study that concluded "there is need for reassessing the carcinogenic potential of aspartame" in finding the cause of an increase in brain tumors.
The food industry defended the safety of the sweetener, pointing to research that led to FDA approval. It said the conclusions of the new study were "based on speculation, not science."
